name: rain-gauge
description: Flagship: multi-part mechanism with research (tipping bucket + 4-dial counter). One-off per model or major skill change.
judge_criteria: Four 0-9 dials that carry like an odometer (0000-9999), readable as mm of rain.
A tipping bucket that mechanically drives the counter, with a credible drive and carry mechanism (ratchet/pawl or Geneva-style) that cannot skip or double-count.
A reset mechanism that returns all four dials to zero.
A round collector of a recognised standard size (e.g. 200 cm2 / 159.6 mm, or the 203 mm / 8 inch gauge), or about 150 mm as suggested, with the choice explained.
Explicit, correct calibration: chamber volume (mL) = collector area (cm2) x rain per tip (mm) / 10, and gearing that makes one units-dial step equal 1 mm.
Every part prints on an X1C without supports, and the assembly and build guide are clear enough to make it.
